upcoming.title: Becoming Her
upcoming.subtitle: The Woman You're Meant to Be
upcoming.descriptionShort: After seasons of survival and healing, many women reach a moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now? This gathering is a space to pause, reflect, and reconnect with yourself.
upcoming.descriptionMedium:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her is an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we will explore identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.
upcoming.descriptionFull:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her is an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we will explore identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.

This gathering creates a space for women to transform past pain into personal power and begin stepping more confidently into the next chapter of their lives.

upcoming.title: The Courage to Choose Yourself
upcoming.subtitle: Boundaries, self-trust, and living a life that is true to you
upcoming.descriptionShort: A one-day container to help you return home to your own knowing and begin making choices from that place.
upcoming.descriptionMedium: A gathering for women ready to honour their boundaries, deepen self-trust, and live more fully in alignment with what is true for them.
upcoming.descriptionFull: A gathering for women ready to honour their boundaries, deepen self-trust, and live more fully in alignment with what is true for them. We make space for honesty about what you need, what you are no longer available for, and how you want to move through the world.

upcoming.title: Healing the Woman Within
upcoming.subtitle: Transforming past pain into personal power
upcoming.descriptionShort: Authentic conversations around identity, womanhood, and the audacity to be seen for exactly who you are becoming.
upcoming.descriptionMedium:
A space to meet the woman within with compassion, and to alchemize old pain into strength and clarity, alongside others walking a similar path.

Registration opens 11 July 2026.
upcoming.descriptionFull:
A space to meet the woman within with compassion, and to alchemize old pain into strength and clarity, alongside others walking a similar path. Through shared reflection and honest conversation, we tend to the parts of our stories that still ask for healing.

Details and registration will open on 11 July 2026.

upcoming.title: The Life I Truly Want
upcoming.subtitle: Creating a life aligned with your truth
upcoming.descriptionShort: For women who know what they want but need the map to get there, with honesty and grace.
upcoming.descriptionMedium:
An invitation to get honest about the life you actually want, and to begin aligning your choices, boundaries, and vision with that truth, in the company of other women doing the same.

Registration opens 5 September 2026.
upcoming.descriptionFull:
An invitation to get honest about the life you actually want, and to begin aligning your choices, boundaries, and vision with that truth, in the company of other women doing the same. We leave space for desire, doubt, and the quiet clarity that comes from naming what matters.

Details and registration will open on 5 September 2026.

past.title: Transform and Thrive
past.subtitle: From Survival to Thriving
past.descriptionShort: The first Elysian House gathering, an intimate space for women moving from surviving toward thriving, with honesty and shared experience.
past.descriptionMedium: Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women moving beyond surviving toward truly thriving. Together they built safety, honesty, and shared reflection; one room grew into a community of women choosing their lives intentionally.
past.descriptionFull:
Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women ready to move beyond surviving and begin the journey of truly thriving.

Women came together in a room built on safety, honesty, and shared experience. Through guided reflection and open conversation, they began to explore what it means not only to manage their lives, but to choose them intentionally.

What started as one room became the foundation of a growing community of women finding their way home to themselves.
past.experienceBlock: Women arrived as strangers and left as a community built on honest conversations, shared stories, and presence without performance.
